release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $137.8m landed in the lower half of the company's own $137-139m guide and slightly under ~$138.4-138.7m consensus (breaking the habitual beat the thesis leaned on), US growth slowed to +7.0%, and the Q4 guide of $125-127m sits about 5% below the ~$132.9m Benzinga estimate; the gross-margin lift to 44.6% and adjusted EPS $0.62 vs ~$0.60 only partly offset it.

vs_bar.note: Company guide $137-139m (midpoint $138m, -0.1%). Other consensus figures: $138.73m (gurufocus), $138.75m (TradingView). Actual from https://www.minichart.com.sg/2026/11/04/xpel-q3-2026-revenue-rises-9-9-to-137-8-million-eps-0-59-q4-outlook-125-127-million/
GAAP EPS $0.59. Other EPS bars: $0.61 Benzinga, $0.58 Investing.com, $0.55 Nasdaq fallback forecast (1 estimate). Gurufocus headline compares GAAP $0.59 and calls it a miss.
No consensus found. 41.8% a year earlier, 44.1% in Q2 2026. Source: minichart summary of the 8-K.

key_line.metric: Q4 2026 revenue guide and beat of own guide
key_line.detail: The thesis was a repeat of Q2's +5% beat of the company's own guide. Q3 came in at $137.8m, in the lower half of $137-139m, so no beat. US region $76.7m, +7.0% (vs +11.7% in Q2); China $15.4m (+52.4%, slightly below Q2's $15.9m); EU/UK/Africa -2.1%; India/ME -16.6%. Q4 guide approx $125-127m against a Benzinga Q4 estimate of $132.9m (from the hunt).

guidance.detail: No prior Q4 company guide existed; the new Q4 guide of $125-127m (midpoint $126m) sits about 5.2% below the street's ~$132.9m (Benzinga, as cited in the stage E-P hunt). Read as guided below the street, not as a cut of a company figure.

call.detail: Call scheduled 08:30 ET today (company notice). It was probably over or ending by 09:17 ET; no call content was found in time, so tone and Q&A are unknown.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines split: gurufocus 'both fall short of estimates' (on GAAP EPS), Investing.com 'earnings beat by $0.04, revenue fell short', rallies.ai 'Q3 profit beats on window film sales, margin expansion'. No analyst action and no pre-market price story found before 09:20 ET. No retail-tone source checked for lack of time.

tape_read.note: Tape as of 09:15 ET shows zero pre-market prints (no last, no high/low, reference null, stale_at_open true). So there is no pre-market price to compare with the -6% release read. The read is 'undershoot' only in the sense that nothing of the release has traded yet; the opening print is the first real price. Market is up firmly (SPY +1.21%, IWM +1.78% pre-market), a small cushion for a small-cap. Prev close 42.49, entry 42.92.

thesis_check.note: The panel's long rested on another beat of the company's own revenue guide plus a crowded short. Revenue landed inside the guide's lower half, a hair under consensus, and the Q4 guide sits about 5% below the street. Margin and adjusted EPS were good, which is the only part that confirms. The crowded short (10.7% of float, 13 days to cover) now works against the long: no beat gives shorts no reason to cover.

expected.open_lag_note: No pre-market prints at all, so the open is the first price discovery and the 'lag' question is undefined against a null reference: 50 as pure uncertainty. A bmo name with an unambiguous negative guide and only 187k shares a day tends to keep repricing lower into the session, so a slightly lower chance than usual of a fade back toward yesterday's close by 10:00; the strong market (IWM +1.8%) is the one force the other way.

recommendation.reason: De omzet haalde de eigen prognose net niet ruim en lag iets onder de verwachting van analisten, en de omzetprognose voor het vierde kwartaal ligt ongeveer 5% onder wat de markt verwachtte; dat ondermijnt precies waarop de longpositie rustte. Er is nog geen voorbeurshandel, dus de opening is de eerste echte prijs, en bij een dunne bmo-naam met slecht nieuws verwachten we eerder verdere daling door de dag dan herstel tot 13:00. Daarom uitstappen bij de opening in plaats van de standaardregel (13:00) af te wachten.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 toch voorbeurskoersen verschijnen die rond of boven het slot van gisteren (42,49) liggen, of als analisten na het gesprek de prognose duidelijk positief uitleggen, dan is vasthouden tot de standaardregel (13:00) te verdedigen.
